dismiss an idea: My boss dismissed my idea as too expensive without even listening to the details of the plan.
我老闆連計畫的細節都沒聽，就以太貴為由對我的想法不屑一顧。
dismiss an employee: The manager had to dismiss an employee who was caught stealing money from the cash register.
經理不得不解雇一名被抓到從收銀機偷錢的員工。
dismiss the case: Because there was not enough evidence, the judge decided to dismiss the case against the young driver.
由於證據不足，法官決定駁回對那位年輕駕駛的案件。
dismiss the class: When the bell rang, the teacher didn't dismiss the class until everyone had handed in the test.
鐘響時，老師直到每個人都交了考卷才讓全班下課。
dismiss concerns: The mayor simply dismissed concerns about air pollution, saying the new factory was completely safe.
市長對空氣汙染的疑慮置之不理，說新工廠完全安全。
dispute the claim: Several scientists dispute the claim that the new drink can help people lose weight without exercise.
好幾位科學家對「這款新飲料能讓人不運動就減重」的說法提出異議。
dispute the result: The losing team plans to dispute the result of the match, saying the referee made several unfair calls.
輸球的隊伍打算質疑比賽結果，說裁判做了幾次不公平的判決。
in dispute: Ownership of the small island has been in dispute between the two countries for over fifty years.
這座小島的主權在兩國之間已經有爭議超過五十年了。
settle a dispute: The two neighbors asked a lawyer to help settle a dispute over where the fence should be built.
兩位鄰居請律師幫忙解決關於圍籬該蓋在哪裡的爭端。
disrupt traffic: The heavy snow disrupted traffic across the city, and many people were late for work.
大雪干擾了全市的交通，許多人上班都遲到了。
disrupt the market: Streaming services disrupted the market for DVDs, and many video rental shops soon closed down.
串流服務顛覆了DVD市場，許多影片出租店很快就倒閉了。
disrupt the class: A student who kept talking loudly on his phone disrupted the class, so the teacher asked him to leave.
一名一直大聲講手機的學生擾亂課堂，所以老師請他離開。
disrupt supply chains: The typhoon disrupted supply chains, cutting off deliveries of computer parts and forcing factories to stop production.
颱風中斷了供應鏈，切斷了電腦零件的運送，迫使工廠停產。
dissolve parliament: The prime minister decided to dissolve parliament and hold a new election next month.
首相決定解散國會，並在下個月舉行新的選舉。
dissolve a marriage: After years of arguing, the couple finally asked the court to dissolve their marriage.
經過多年的爭吵，這對夫妻終於請求法院解除他們的婚姻。
dissolve into tears: When she heard that her old dog had died, the little girl dissolved into tears.
聽到她的老狗死了，小女孩哭了起來。
sugar dissolves: Stir the tea for a few seconds until the sugar dissolves completely, and then add some milk.
把茶攪拌幾秒鐘，直到糖完全溶解，然後加一些牛奶。
the partnership dissolved: After the two owners argued about money, the partnership dissolved and they each opened their own shop.
兩位老闆為錢爭吵之後，合夥解散了，他們各自開了自己的店。
distinguish right from wrong: Parents should teach their kids to distinguish right from wrong from a very young age.
父母應該從孩子很小的時候就教他們分辨是非。
distinguish oneself: He distinguished himself in the science competition by winning first prize with his water-saving invention.
他以節水發明贏得第一名，在科學競賽中嶄露頭角。
distinguish between: Many people cannot distinguish between the two twins because they look exactly the same.
很多人無法區分這對雙胞胎，因為他們長得一模一樣。
a distinguished scholar: As a distinguished scholar who has won many international awards, Professor Lin was invited to speak at Harvard.
身為一位贏得許多國際獎項的傑出學者，林教授受邀到哈佛演講。
distract attention from: The politician told jokes to distract attention from the serious problems in his own party.
這位政治人物講笑話來轉移大家對他自己政黨嚴重問題的注意。
be distracted by noise: I keep losing my place in the book because I am easily distracted by noise from the construction site next door.
我一直看到忘記讀到哪裡，因為我很容易被隔壁工地的噪音分心。
distract oneself: When I feel nervous before a big test, I distract myself by listening to my favorite songs.
大考前覺得緊張時，我會聽最喜歡的歌來讓自己分心。
distribute leaflets: Volunteers stood outside the train station to distribute leaflets about the free health check.
志工們站在火車站外發傳單，宣傳免費健康檢查。
distribute wealth: Many people believe the government should distribute wealth more fairly between the rich and the poor.
許多人認為政府應該在富人和窮人之間更公平地分配財富。
be evenly distributed: Rainfall in this area is evenly distributed throughout the year, so farmers rarely worry about dry seasons.
這個地區的雨量全年平均分布，所以農夫很少擔心乾季。
distribute goods: The company distributes goods through over three thousand convenience stores and online shops across Taiwan.
這家公司透過全台三千多家便利商店和網路商店配銷商品。
